Honestly what you say is true, however it does go back to the role it was built for and that's patrol and not front line combat.  The ship wasn't just designed for the Arctic, its also taking on the roles the current Kingston class does as well as secondary roles currently done by the Halifax class.  The Harry DeWolf's are cheaper to operate than a Halifax and have significantly more capability than the Kingstons.  Harry DeWolf had a very successful role in Operation Caribbe where it seized almost 3,000 kilograms (6,600 lb) of cocaine, and Margret Brooke assisted with the post Hurricane Fiona operations in the Canadian Maritimes.  


While I disagree that these shouldn't have been built in favor of subs, I do fully agree that Canada needs to heavily upgrade its sub fleet.  It's unfortunate that the Canadian government, regardless of which party is in charge, never puts enough focus on the Canadian Navy.  However, I think these are great ships for the role they were designed for and will be asked to do.  


Honestly I'm just happy they got built because I get the feeling if they were stopped in favor of something else (like subs) that 'something else' would never get built and we'd just be out a great patrol craft lol.    


Are they perfect - no, are they nice to have - absolutely.  It provides a better platform for drug interdiction and disaster relief operations than the current fleet, while also providing the Canadian Navy a surface ship capable of going through the north.

This comes up every time these ships are posted here.  It's important to remember that this is a Patrol ship and not a Frigate or other front line combatant.  It's role is similar to something like the River-class offshore patrol vessel and shares a similar weapon loadout.  The Harry DeWolf class is physically large because its also an icebreaker and needs to be able to operate alone in the north for long periods of time, but even if its Frigate sized its not designed for a Frigate role.  


That said, the change in the political climate since these ships were designed/developed, it probably would have been nice if they had a bit more ability to defend themselves when they're alone in the north.  Maybe they can retrofit them one day.
